topic: This week in AI: the top 5 stories you need to know
post:
This week, AI left the lab and hit real life: money, law and land. 🌍
Here are the top 5 stories you need to know.

1️⃣ Anthropic hits the road
Anthropic launched the roadshow for its IPO, with a proposed price of $70 to $78 per share. Pricing is reportedly expected around Nov 18.

2️⃣ Voters push back on data centers
In local ballot measures across about 10 states, opponents of data centers won almost every vote, per Route Fifty and Stateline. 🗳️

3️⃣ AI meets your bank account
Anthropic began rolling out a read-only Personal Finance beta in Claude for US Pro, Max and Ultra users.

4️⃣ The DOJ gets an AI task force
The Justice Department launched a Super Intelligence Task Force to fight AI misuse by foreign actors and fraudsters. ⚖️

5️⃣ A $129M deepfake fraud case
Prosecutors charged three men in an alleged scheme that used AI to impersonate CEOs and lawyers.

Why it matters:
AI is no longer just a tech story. It's showing up in stock markets, ballot boxes, bank accounts and courtrooms. 💡

Practical takeaway:
Pick the one story that touches your work, and spend 5 minutes reading the original source this weekend. 🔍

Which story matters most to you? 👇

Follow for daily AI news you can actually use.
